title: Describing Places and Animals
ringkas: Mendeskripsikan tempat, hewan, dan benda dalam teks
goals: memahami struktur **descriptive text**: Identification dan Description
mendeskripsikan **tempat**, **hewan**, dan **benda** dengan kalimat yang rapi
memakai [[is / are]], [[has / have]], dan [[there is / there are]] dalam deskripsi
menambah kata sifat dan pelengkap tempat: [[very]], [[quite]], [[famous]], [[located in]]
membaca teks deskripsi pendek dan menjawab pertanyaan tentang isinya

lesson.text: Di Kelas 7 kamu mendeskripsikan **orang dan benda**. Sekarang kamu belajar membuat **teks deskripsi yang utuh**, misalnya tentang **tempat wisata, hewan peliharaan,** atau **ruang kelasmu**. Ini disebut **descriptive text**.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur descriptive text
table: memperkenalkan apa atau siapa yang dideskripsikan
[[Borobudur Temple is a famous Buddhist temple in Magelang, Central Java.]]
ciri-ciri: bentuk, ukuran, warna, bagian, sifat, dan kegiatan
[[It is very old and big. It has many stairs and statues.]]

lesson.title: Aturan bahasa
lesson.text: Descriptive text umumnya memakai **simple present tense**, kata sifat (adjective), dan kata kerja **to be, have/has**, serta **there is/are**. Gunakan **it / they** agar tidak mengulang nama.

items.ex: Bali is famous for its beaches.
There is a view of the sea.
A monkey has a long tail.
A tiger is a wild animal.

lines.en: Borobudur Temple is a famous Buddhist temple in Magelang, Central Java. It is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Indonesia.
lines.id: Candi Borobudur adalah candi Buddha yang terkenal di Magelang, Jawa Tengah. Candi ini salah satu tempat wisata paling populer di Indonesia. (Identification)

lines.en: The temple is very old and big. It has many stairs, statues, and beautiful carvings on the walls.
lines.id: Candinya sangat tua dan besar. Candi ini memiliki banyak tangga, patung, dan ukiran indah di dindingnya. (Description)

lines.en: Visitors can enjoy a great view of the sunrise from the top of the temple.
lines.id: Pengunjung bisa menikmati pemandangan matahari terbit yang indah dari puncak candi. (Description)

lines.en: I have a pet cat. Her name is Mimi.
lines.id: Aku punya kucing peliharaan. Namanya Mimi. (Identification)

lines.en: She is small and fat. She has soft white fur and a long tail. She has two green eyes and four short legs.
lines.id: Dia kecil dan gemuk. Bulunya putih lembut dan ekornya panjang. Dia punya dua mata hijau dan empat kaki pendek. (Description: penampilan)

lines.en: Mimi is friendly and playful. She sleeps a lot, and she loves eating fish.
lines.id: Mimi ramah dan suka bermain. Dia banyak tidur dan suka makan ikan. (Description: sifat dan kebiasaan)

lesson.title: 4. Pola kalimat yang berguna
table: **X is a/an + adjective + noun + in/at + tempat**
[[Kuta Beach is a famous beach in Bali.]]
[[There are many shops near the beach.]]

lesson.title: Hindari mengulang nama terus-menerus
lesson.text: Setelah menyebut nama sekali, ganti dengan **it** (benda/tempat/hewan) atau **they** (banyak). Daripada *Mimi is small. Mimi has fur. Mimi is friendly*, tulis [[Mimi is small. She has soft fur. She is friendly.]]

items: Pakai **simple present**, adjective, [[is / are]], [[has / have]], dan [[there is / there are]].
Pola: [[X is a famous ... in ...]], [[It is ...]], [[It has ...]], [[Visitors can ...]].
Ganti nama dengan **it / she / he / they** agar teks tidak monoton.

read.id:
Gajah adalah hewan darat terbesar. Gajah punya belalai panjang, dua telinga besar, dan kulit abu-abu yang tebal.
Gajah hidup di hutan dan savana di Afrika dan Asia. Mereka makan rumput, daun, dan buah. Seekor gajah bisa makan lebih dari seratus kilo makanan sehari. Gajah sangat cerdas, dan mereka hidup berkelompok.

qs.q: What color is an elephant's skin?

options: Meat, fish, and small insects from the forest
Only fish and meat from the rivers
Insects, eggs, and small animals on the savanna

read.text:
The elephant is the biggest land animal. It has a long trunk, two large ears, and thick grey skin.
Elephants live in forests and savannas in Africa and Asia. They eat grass, leaves, and fruit. An elephant can eat more than one hundred kilos of food a day. Elephants are very smart, and they live in groups.
read.title: The Elephant

read.id:
Raja Ampat adalah gugusan pulau di Papua. Tempat ini terkenal dengan lautnya yang biru jernih dan ikan-ikan berwarna-warni. Banyak wisatawan ke sana untuk menyelam.
Pulau-pulaunya hijau, tenang, dan bersih. Tidak ada pusat perbelanjaan besar, hanya penginapan kecil. Untuk ke sana, pengunjung harus naik pesawat lalu naik perahu.

qs.q: What is Raja Ampat famous for?

qs.exp: Teks: "take a plane and then a boat."
options: By train, and then by a small bus
By car only, along a long road
By bus, and then by a bicycle

read.text:
Raja Ampat is a group of islands in Papua. It is famous for its clear blue sea and colorful fish. Many tourists go there to dive.
The islands are green, quiet, and clean. There are no big shopping centers, only small homestays. To get there, visitors must take a plane and then a boat.
read.title: Raja Ampat

read.focus: Present simple untuk fakta dan deskripsi
read.id:
Di savana Afrika, singa hidup dalam kelompok yang disebut pride. Singa punya tubuh kuat dan gigi tajam. Singa makan daging, jadi mereka karnivora. Mereka tidur sekitar dua puluh jam setiap hari.
Zebra dan jerapah makan rumput dan daun. Mereka herbivora. Jerapah punya leher yang sangat panjang, jadi bisa menjangkau pohon yang tinggi. Zebra berlari cepat ketika singa mendekat.

qs.q: Why can a giraffe reach tall trees?

qs.exp: Fakta umum tentang hewan → present simple.
qs.q: Why does the writer use the present simple?
Lions ___ (sleep) for about twenty hours a day.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Zebra berlari cepat."

read.text:
In the African savanna, lions live in groups called prides. A lion has a strong body and sharp teeth. Lions eat meat, so they are carnivores. They sleep for about twenty hours every day.
Zebras and giraffes eat grass and leaves. They are herbivores. A giraffe has a very long neck, so it can reach the tall trees. Zebras run fast when a lion comes near.
read.title: The Savanna Animals

read.focus: Present simple: pertanyaan, negatif, dan can untuk hewan
read.id:
Rina mengunjungi kebun binatang bersama adik kecilnya. "Apakah pinguin bisa terbang?" tanyanya. "Tidak. Pinguin tidak bisa terbang, tetapi bisa berenang sangat cepat," jawab Rina. "Apakah mereka hidup di tempat panas?" "Tidak. Mereka hidup di tempat dingin, seperti Antartika."
"Monyet makan apa?" "Monyet makan buah dan daun. Monyet tidak makan daging." "Apakah monyet bisa memanjat pohon?" "Ya, bisa. Mereka memanjat dengan sangat baik karena punya lengan panjang." Anak kecil itu tersenyum. "Aku paling suka monyet."

qs.exp: Teks: "They live in cold places, like Antarctica."

qs.q: Choose the correct answer: "Can monkeys climb trees?" "Yes, they ___."

qs.exp: Jamak negatif → don't + kata kerja dasar.

qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Pinguin tidak bisa terbang."

read.text:
Rina visits the zoo with her little brother. "Do penguins fly?" he asks. "No, they don't. Penguins can't fly, but they can swim very fast," Rina answers. "Do they live in hot places?" "No, they don't. They live in cold places, like Antarctica."
"What does a monkey eat?" "A monkey eats fruit and leaves. It doesn't eat meat." "Can monkeys climb trees?" "Yes, they can. They climb very well because they have long arms." The little boy smiles. "I like monkeys the most."
read.title: Do Penguins Fly?

read.focus: Used to untuk kebiasaan dan keadaan masa lalu
read.id:
Tom: Kakek, apakah Kakek selalu tinggal di kota ini? Kakek: Ya, tetapi dulu kota ini sangat kecil. Dulu hanya ada satu jalan, dan kami tidak punya pasar. Tom: Dulu Kakek biasa melakukan apa untuk bersenang-senang?
Kakek: Kami biasa bermain di sungai, dan biasa menangkap ikan dengan tangan. Sekarang sungainya kotor. Tom: Itu menyedihkan. Kakek: Ya. Tetapi kota ini sudah berkembang, dan sekarang punya banyak taman.

read.text:
Tom: Grandpa, did you always live in this city? Grandpa: Yes, but it used to be very small. There used to be only one road, and we didn't use to have a market. Tom: What did you use to do for fun?
Grandpa: We used to play in the river, and we used to catch fish with our hands. Now the river is dirty. Tom: That's sad. Grandpa: Yes. But the city has grown, and it has many parks now.
read.title: The City Used to Be Small

read.focus: Preposisi tempat hewan: in, on, at, near, under, around
read.id:
Tom: Di mana monyet hidup? Rani: Mereka hidup di hutan, dan tidur di pohon. Beberapa monyet hidup di pulau kecil. Tom: Dan pinguin? Rani: Mereka hidup di tempat dingin, di atas es, dekat laut.
Tom: Apa yang dilakukan burung hantu pada malam hari? Rani: Mereka berburu tikus, dan beristirahat di lubang di bawah pohon besar pada siang hari. Tom: Di mana buaya ditemukan? Rani: Di sungai dan danau di seluruh dunia. Mereka berbaring di tepi sungai di bawah matahari.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan at, in, atau on:

qs.answer: They hunt for mice at night.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Mereka berburu tikus pada malam hari."

read.text:
Tom: Where do monkeys live? Rani: They live in the forest, and they sleep in trees. Some monkeys live on small islands. Tom: And penguins? Rani: They live in cold places, on the ice, near the sea.
Tom: What do owls do at night? Rani: They hunt for mice, and they rest in holes under big trees during the day. Tom: Where are crocodiles found? Rani: In rivers and lakes around the world. They lie on the bank in the sun.
read.title: Where Do They Live?
